title: Landfall and Current
author: Jude Halloran
blurb: Lior Brightwater, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
